changelog: Fix: restore activities were missing from the Activities page entirely. UrBackup records restores in its own `restores` table, which St0r never read — only the backups and backup_images tables were queried, so image and file restores appeared nowhere in the history (issue #17)

New: Activities now lists file and image restores alongside backups, with an amber 'Image Restore' / 'File Restore' badge, the restored path on hover, failure status from UrBackup's success flag, and a 'Restores' type filter
Fix: a restore still in progress no longer shows a green success tick in the history — it renders as running until UrBackup records a finish time
Fix: running restores reported by the progress API were matched against unrelated backup records, which stamped them with the wrong start time
